name: commKit
description: Addon messaging of any length for World of Warcraft addons: prefixes, a chunk protocol with bounded reassembly, priority queues that refuse rather than grow, and a bandwidth budget shared with the whole session; content-hash sync sets and chat and Battle.net sends as optional parts.
summary: Addon messaging of any length: a chunk protocol with bounded reassembly, refusing priority queues, a session bandwidth budget and sync sets.

SyncSet.description: scope:SyncSet: named fields synchronised with peers by content hash, answering only with the fields that differ.

ChatThrottle.description: scope:SendChat and Battle.net game data (scope:SendBattleNet, scope:RegisterBattleNet) through the shared bandwidth budget, the senders ChatThrottleLib throttles beside addon messages.
